g.aria-label: Step 1 · Apply Multivariate Itô’s Lemma to Smooth Test Bump φ(X_t) & Take E[·]
d/dt E[φ(X_t)] = ∫ φ(x) ∂_t p_t(x) dx = ∫ [ ∇φ · f + ½ g(t)² Δφ ] p_t(x) dx
Step 2 · Integrate by Parts (1 Sign Flip on ∇·, 2 Sign Flips on Δ = ∇·∇)
∫ (∇φ · f) p_t dx = −∫ φ ∇·(f p_t) dx, ∫ (Δφ) p_t dx = +∫ φ Δp_t dx
Step 3 · Holds for Every Bump φ ⇒ Pointwise Fokker–Planck Equation
∂_t p_t(x) = −∇ · (f(x, t) p_t(x)) + ½ g(t)² Δp_t(x)
